introduction: Cypress runs browser checks as a chain of commands. This example starts with a blank local practice page. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.text: Cypress runs browser checks as a chain of commands. This example starts with a blank local practice page.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: Use a local Cypress project. Set baseUrl to your local static frontend address and create a blank practice.html there. These test files do not run in this website's code sandbox.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of Cypress. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.

blocks.title: Meet the Cypress runner

blocks.text: The test inserts and checks a Library heading on the local page.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Change the heading to Reading club.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Serve a blank practice.html from your local frontend project and configure baseUrl first.
For more detail later, use this [Cypress further reading](https://docs.cypress.io/app/get-started/why-cypress).
